description:
🎓 Specially developed for DHBW Horb
This app was exclusively developed for students at DHBW Stuttgart Campus Horb and provides you with a complete overview of your daily study life.
⏰ Main Features
Schedule always at hand:
• Clear display of your personal timetable
• All lectures, seminars and appointments at a glance
• Easy navigation through the weekdays
• Current information about room and lecturer
